record_kind: PENDING REFINED DESIGN-SCOPE-ONLY REQUEST; NOT A PROPERTY CONFIRMATION REQUEST
scope: Permission to DESIGN OFFLINE a representation-independent evidence relation between one fresh current hardware operation T and its preserved authoritative result R, using only permitted requirements/interfaces. No implementation, mechanism choice, replacement restricted operation or live use.
not_a_technical_confirmation: An affirmative design-scope decision would not confirm G01_prime/G02_prime for the existing module, prove a defect, or approve an eventual design.

exact_context.freshness: Boot and 70/70 first-owner facts are preserved historical observations, not fresh invocation guards.

required_semantic_output: Independently establish that one preserved authoritative result R faithfully represents the accepted terminal events, terminal phase/results and retirement-gated color capture genuinely generated by one fresh current hardware operation T: R belongs to T.
representation_independent_requirements: Terminal state/results belong to that operation.
Retirement-gated color capture belongs to that operation.
Terminal state/results and color capture share one transaction provenance.
Evidence survives until protected preservation; valid pre-release snapshots are permitted.
Failure, incomplete or lost reporting remains UNKNOWN unless narrower facts are independently established.
No retry after possible ambiguous issuance.
A future design must be independently qualifiable offline before any separately approved live use; no synthetic test may certify physical hardware behavior.
allowed_inputs: Permitted owner/session/service/backend API signatures, embedding, acceptance/reset/retirement/readback invariants.
Public UAPI and exact approved response exporter source/behavior.
Existing unrestricted qualification metadata and CPU mock tests, within their established limits.
Unrestricted evidence requirements and approved clean-room scope.
Independently permitted property-level guarantees attributable to this exact qualified artifact, if available.

input_boundary_inheritance.rule: Existing FORBIDDEN and UNKNOWN inputs stay excluded. An allowed component interface/requirement does not authorize its execution, modification or restricted implementation access.

forbidden_inputs_and_actions: Excluded ioctl-entry/reporting or historical wrapper contents, control flow, integration tests revealing those contents, or reconstruction hints.
Alternate representations, disassembly, indirect recovery, inferred hidden behavior or derivation from restricted material.
Equivalent indirect substitution for the blocked operation or recreation of restricted entry/reporting/wrapper implementation.
Hardware contact, live guards/logs, staging, installation, boot, recovery, client/ioctl/SGX execution or retry.
Kernel/module/UAPI/client changes, patches, builds, implementation or deployment.
contamination_stop_rule: If a design branch requires excluded/UNKNOWN material, reconstruction, derivation, indirect recovery, historical-wrapper recreation or equivalent indirect substitution for a blocked operation, STOP that branch and return its dependency to review. Do not infer hidden behavior or obtain material through another route.
reuse_priority: Approved one-call response-export client unchanged where possible.
Public request/response ABI unchanged where possible.
Qualified owner/session accepted-event semantics and retirement-gated readback.
Offline evidence archive/checker and preservation primitives.
Existing guard requirements/components within their established scopes; historical records are not fresh observations.
Current readiness and exact-client decisions within their bounded scopes.
qualification_impact: This pending request changes no source/binary/ABI/module/image or established qualification. A future design must identify exact changed dependencies before proposing implementation; no blanket invalidation.
explicit_exclusions: No implementation, patch, build, kernel/module/UAPI/client change or ABI selection.
No installation, deployment, staging, target contact, hardware interaction, live guards/logs, boot change or recovery.
No client/ioctl/SGX execution or retry; no substitute launcher/executor.
No restricted-source access, reopening, reconstruction, derivation, indirect recovery or recreation of excluded reporting/wrapper machinery.
No technical certification of current G01_prime/G02_prime; no triangle claim; no execution authorization.
approval_boundary: Only an explicit project-maintainer decision on this bounded request may grant its design scope. Current instruction to prepare/dispose the review is not silently recorded as that approval; prior observation-design approval is not expanded.
future_boundaries: Design review, implementation authority, live-use authority and execution authorization remain separate; this request imposes no new representation-specific gate.
next_step: Maintainer disposition of this refined independent design scope, then design only if explicitly approved.
